summary: PACZKA 11 frontend-only testing (Playwright, desktop 1920 + mobile 375). 9 of 10 flows pass. One failure: after submitting the business register form, a new user lands on /business/dashboard and not on /business/onboarding.

ui_bugs.issue: After a successful POST /business/register the toast 'Firma zarejestrowana' shows, but the user ends up on /business/dashboard, not /business/onboarding. Likely cause: `await refresh()` runs before navigate(). refresh() puts business_id on the user, so the component re-renders and the guard `if (user.business_id) return <Navigate to="/business/dashboard"/>` fires before navigate('/business/onboarding') is reached. /business/onboarding itself loads fine when opened directly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: qa_p11_new now owns a business, so to retest the register -> onboarding redirect you need another fresh user without a business (register limit is 3/day per user). The preview ingress sometimes returns 429 on Vite module requests after many page loads, which gives a blank white page; wait about 60s and retry. LangSync makes user.language override localStorage; use the switcher or PUT /api/auth/me {language}.
rca of the issue: BusinessRegister.submit runs `await refresh()` and then navigate('/business/onboarding'). Once refresh() resolves, the AuthContext user has business_id, so BusinessRegister re-renders, returns <Navigate to='/business/dashboard' replace/> and unmounts. The later navigate call loses the race or is ignored, and the user stays on /business/dashboard. Observed: after submit, page.url = /business/dashboard. Fix: navigate first, or use a ref flag to skip the guard after a successful submit.
